description:
fz-sc8.159 makes quiescence a whole-stack decision: a nested drive that runs dry defers (settles nothing, unwinds, is served again), and only the outermost drain arbitrates. That rule exists because drives nest: a drain inside one drive can start another drive beneath it.

This ticket removes the nesting. When no drain starts a drive beneath an active one, there is no stack to be quiescent about, and the mechanism fz-sc8.159 adds goes away: Driven<T> { Finished, Deferred }, Drained::Deferred, the recorded waits of suspended drives on ProductSessions, the deferred-drive telemetry event and its pins.

Not spiked. It changes how requests are served (drive.rs, product_drive.rs, pull.rs), so it needs a spike and a proposal page first: measure request counts on the eighteen programs fz-sc8.159 measured, the distiller spend pin, and both stall shapes (stall 1: Program held across a root; stall 2: a root held across a Program drive).

Also decide here whether parking a request on its own active scope (next_request) can go; removing it alone panics fixture 00882 ("one product session cannot be driven recursively").

Blocks the epic so the added mechanism is not forgotten.
title: A drain starts no drive beneath an active one
